rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a finding or the act of discovering something new.

example.traditional: 呢個發現真係幾令人意外。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 faat3 jin6 zan1 hai6 gei2 ling6 jan4 ji3 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this for discovery understood as an intentional process of exploring or seeking out new things, especially on a voyage or in research.

example.english: This space exploration led to a major discovery.
example.traditional: 呢次太空探索令科學家有重大發現。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 taai3 hung1 taam3 sok3 ling6 fo1 hok6 gaa1 jau5 zung6 daai6 faat3 jin6
